gold.$description: Hawkeye Gold. Used at full strength only.

neutral.$description: Text, surfaces, borders, dividers, and structure. Every gray in the system resolves to one of these eleven. Step names are ordinals, so a higher number is darker and a step can be inserted without renumbering.

blue-dark.$description: Darker blue. Clears AA as link text on white and gray surfaces, which blue does not.

info-wash.$description: Background fill behind an info message.

success-wash.$description: Background fill behind a success message.

warning-wash.$description: Background fill behind a warning message.

danger-wash.$description: Background fill behind an error message.

alpha.$description: Translucent colors. The number is the alpha per-mille, so black-125 is rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.125).
